thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 — Region us-west-2: GPU capacity shortage detected. Queue growth +40% across inference pools, latency > SLO for L7 routes. Auto-rollback/protect: enabled. Paging oncall.

oncall-amber: Acked. Joining bridge. What's the scale? I see increased preemptions in pool-gpu-a.

sre-jordan: I'm on it. Preemptions from spot reclaim + two AZs showing elevated host churn. Checking autoscaler events...

sre-jordan: (logs) ```kubectl -n inference get events --field-selector reason=Preempted | tail -n 30``` seeing repeated GCE_PREEMPTION entries + spot eviction spikes at 1939997820.

eng-runtime-lee: Noted. Any routes impacted or only background queueing?

oncall-amber: 10% of requests are falling back to queued mode, user-facing latency on /v1/generate for some tenants > 2s.

cs-rahul: Heads-up — we have two Dedicated customers with strict latency SLAs in us-west-2. I'm opening a customer impact log: INC-4087.

eng-platform-nina: Quick mitigation — can we fail over some traffic to us-west-1 or to a smaller quantized variant? What's safe?

sre-jordan: We can temporary route non-critical traffic to us-west-1 and enable fallback-quantized for best-effort. Routing policy change now: ```rictl routing set --from-region us-west-2 --to-region us-west-1 --match route=non-critical --weight 30```.

oncall-amber: Executed routing change. :white_check_mark: Monitoring queue.

eng-runtime-lee: I'm enabling the quantized variant for the gpt-small-compat model to reduce memory pressure: ```deployer promote --model gpt-small-q8 --region us-west-2 --pool pool-gpu-a --force```.

sre-jordan: Pre-warmed 5 extra nodes in pool-gpu-b and bumped thin-provisioning to 1.2x to absorb burst. ```autoscaler override --pool pool-gpu-b --min 5 --max 50```.

incident-bot: Alert suppressed temporarily (mitigation applied). Remember to document actions for postmortem.

oncall-amber: Current status — queue growth stabilized, latency trending down but still borderline for Dedicated customers. Need manual customer notices? @cs-rahul

cs-rahul: Sending a proactive note to affected customers now. Draft: "We observed transient increased latency in us-west-2 due to GPU host churn; mitigation in progress; we may route traffic to nearby region. We'll follow up with post-incident details." Sending.

prod-lina: Schedule a postmortem and assign action owners. Can we meet tomorrow 09:30 PST? Set doc in /docs/incidents/1939998888-postmortem.md

eng-platform-nina: I can lead remediation item on autoscaler tuning. Proposed action items:
- Produce a runbook for spot preemption detection and automatic pool draining
- Add regional fallback policy test to canary suite
- Adjust autoscaler thresholds for AZ-level churn

eng-runtime-lee: I'll own model-variant fallback automation and add circuit-breaker for quantized promotion.

sre-jordan: I'll own infra capacity plan: increase thin-prov headroom, add surge buffer config per region, and run a chaos test for spot preemption.

oncall-amber: I'll create immediate tasks in the incident tracker and set owner/ETA. Preliminary action list:
- (P1) Postmortem doc created — owner: oncall-amber — ETA: today EOD
- (P1) Customer notices logged — owner: cs-rahul — ETA: 30m
- (P2) Autoscaler runbook draft — owner: eng-platform-nina — ETA: 3d
- (P2) Fallback automation PR — owner: eng-runtime-lee — ETA: 5d
- (P2) Capacity buffer config — owner: sre-jordan — ETA: 2d

incident-bot: Reminder — add severity, MTTD/MTTR fields to postmortem doc. Template: /playbooks/postmortem-template.md

cs-rahul: Customer notices sent. Two replies: one asked for SLA credit if repeats, escalated to account team.

prod-lina: Noting action item to discuss SLA policy for routing to other regions. Owner: prod-lina — ETA: 1w.

eng-platform-nina: Quick note — we should add a metric alert for AZ-local eviction rate > 5% in last 5m.

sre-jordan: Created alert: ```alert: AZSpotEvictionRateHigh
expr: evictions_by_az / hosts_by_az > 0.05
for: 5m
``` Added paging to infra-oncall.

oncall-amber: Nice. Current last_message: queue stable, 95th latency down to 800ms from 2200ms at peak. Keeping bridge open for 60m for follow-ups.

prod-lina: Postmortem scheduled: 193 include: eng-runtime, eng-platform, sre, cs, product. 09:30 PST tomorrow. Doc path: /docs/incidents/1939998888-postmortem.md

eng-runtime-lee: Will attach logs and the failover commands to the doc. Also adding a short experiment plan for fallback automation.

sre-jordan: After-action note: prelim root cause — spot preemption cascade + autoscaler thresholds not tuned for 2-AZ simultaneous churn. Need to verify quota for reserved capacity for critical customers.

oncall-amber: Closing active mitigation. We'll continue tracking action items in the doc. Thanks all. :pray:
